description: Experimental Hardware Validation, Provenance Audit, and 4-State Edge Qualification

pulse_ecm_soh_c.dataset_conditions: 0.35% was achieved on single-temperature (25°C) synthetic pulse aging; 1.919% is the true test error across multi-temperature (15°C, 25°C, 45°C) and multi-SOC (20%, 50%, 80%) HPPC transients with Arrhenius kinetic shifts.
pulse_ecm_soh_c.qualification_status: PROVISIONALLY_QUALIFIED (Point Estimate RMSE ~1.92% across full T/SOC envelope; 0.35% on isothermal 25°C only)

empirical_powerlaw_soh_c.dataset_conditions: 0.21%-0.25% is valid strictly on monotonic early-life / steady cycling (cycles 1-25); 0.812%-0.885% occurs across full 60 cycles of commercial batches containing rapid nonlinear knee-point rollover.
empirical_powerlaw_soh_c.qualification_status: QUALIFIED for Steady-State Regime (Cycles with SOH_C >= 0.90); UNVALIDATED after knee rollover without active regime monitoring

gru_uncertainty_coverage.dataset_conditions: 96.7% was evaluated on pristine BOL cycles only; heteroskedastic degradation variance during mid-life causes under-coverage unless variance-studentized adaptive scaling is used.
gru_uncertainty_coverage.qualification_status: Point Estimate: QUALIFIED (0.525% RMSE) | Uncertainty: PROVISIONALLY_QUALIFIED (Full-life coverage 86.0% < nominal 95.0%)

hppc_provenance_audit.underlying_origin: Analytic 2-RC Equivalent Circuit Model transient synthesis with simulated Gaussian sensor noise
hppc_provenance_audit.impact_on_qualification: Results derived from StandardizedHppcCohortGenerator validate algorithm identifiability and pipeline mechanics under simulation, NOT physical cell hardware qualification.
hppc_provenance_audit.status: Classified as SIMULATION benchmark. SOH_R promotion to production-qualified on physical cells requires real cycler HPPC data.

mit_severson.provenance: High-rate delta-V / delta-I step during fast charging

physical_resistance_validation.physical_qualification_verdict: PROVISIONALLY_QUALIFIED (Lacks standardized 10s HPPC reference pulse matrix on physical benches)

knee_point_monitoring.mechanism: Rolling degradation rate d(SOH)/d(Ah) and cumulative prediction residual divergence

edge_hardware_execution.timing_provenance: Direct Host Hardware Timings (time.perf_counter_ns) vs Target MCU Static Instruction-Cycle Calculations

qualification_matrix_4state.soh_r_point_evidence: Validated on simulation HPPC cohort; pending physical bench HPPC dataset
qualification_matrix_4state.soh_r_uncertainty_evidence: Simulation HPPC PICP=100%; physical validation pending

qualification_matrix_4state.soh_c_uncertainty_evidence: Static empirical variance does not dynamically adapt to degradation acceleration
qualification_matrix_4state.soh_r_point_evidence: No physical impedance modeling; excluded from production resistance state
